about.firstParagraph: Senior Frontend Developer with over a decade of experience developing web and mobile applications. Passionate about creating intuitive and accessible interfaces. Experienced in adopting Artificial Intelligence to optimize processes, improve delivery quality, and increase development efficiency.
about.secondParagraph: Throughout my career, I have collaborated with multidisciplinary teams to deliver solutions for major companies, including Itaú, BTG Pactual, Porto Seguro, Sesc Digital, Hyundai, and Avianca, as well as clients across different industries.

ciT.description: Senior Frontend Developer working on financial projects for Itaú and Rabobank.
items: Developed an Angular solution to automate the creation of landing pages, increasing team efficiency and project visibility.
Developed interfaces for the Investment division, automating brokers' activities and making their workflows faster and more efficient.
Increased test coverage to 100% with the support of a generative LLM.

gft.description: Senior Frontend Developer on BTG Pactual's Internet Banking project, using Angular with a microfrontend architecture.
items: Developed authentication features, password creation and recovery flows, as well as interfaces for statements, accounts, and cards.
Developed and evolved Design System components, contributing to standardization, reusability, and greater development efficiency.

deloitte.description: Frontend Tech Lead on digital projects for Sesc Digital and Porto Seguro.
items: Provided technical leadership for the team, participating in recruitment, mentoring, and training, as well as contributing to the definition of development best practices and technical solutions.
At Sesc Digital, developed the public-facing platform and administrative dashboard, expanding access to cultural content.
At Porto Seguro Auto, developed features for insurance brokers, making the insurance contracting process more automated, efficient, and intuitive.

accenture.description: Worked on projects for clients including Avianca, Santander, Hyundai, Grupo DPSP, Gerdau, GSK, and Vivo.
items: Provided training, technical support, and guidance to teams, contributing to professional development and the adoption of best practices.
At Avianca Brazil, developed accessible interfaces following WCAG guidelines.
At Avianca Colombia, trained the team in Bogotá on development best practices and Web Accessibility.
At Grupo DPSP, developed a digital solution for point-of-sale programs, making processes faster, more efficient, and intuitive.

Worked across the entire solution development lifecycle, from database modeling to the development of administrative dashboards, enabling clients to manage content and information for their corporate websites more efficiently.
Applied software engineering best practices such as SOLID, MVC, and TDD, focusing on clean, well-structured, and maintainable code.
